scripts.build: npm run build:dist && npm run verify:preload
scripts.validate:local: npm run lint:js && npm run check:bom && npm run check:eol && npm run lint:css && node scripts/css-import-order-gate.js && node scripts/css-duplicate-selector-gate.js && node scripts/verify-i18n-completeness.js && npm run build:preload
scripts.validate:release: npm run lint:js && npm run check:bom && npm run check:eol && npm run lint:css && node scripts/css-import-order-gate.js && node scripts/css-duplicate-selector-gate.js && node scripts/verify-i18n-completeness.js && npm run build:preload:sap && npm run verify:preload && npm run gate:release
scripts.check:bom: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const walk=(dir)=>fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap((entry)=>{const full=dir+'/'+entry.name;if(entry.isDirectory())return walk(full);return /\.js$/i.test(entry.name)?[full]:[];});const files=walk('app');const bom=Buffer.from([0xef,0xbb,0xbf]);const bad=files.filter((f)=>fs.readFileSync(f).slice(0,3).equals(bom));if(bad.length){console.error('BOM found in:', bad.join(', '));process.exit(1);}console.log('BOM check: OK');"
scripts.verify:preload: node -e "var fs=require('fs');try{var z=fs.statSync('dist/Component-preload.js').size;if(z<50000){process.stderr.write('ERROR: Component-preload.js stub ('+z+' bytes)\n');process.exit(1);}console.log('OK: Component-preload.js '+z+' bytes');}catch(e){process.stderr.write('ERROR: dist/Component-preload.js not found\n');process.exit(1);}"
